purpose: Correct terrain tracer inconsistency using common dry-air mass for vapor advection, mixing-ratio diffusion and conservative storms; repeat the same fixed humidity ratios with unchanged Earth and climate gates.
physical_definition: Two conservative transport branches with fixed humidity profile. Lower dry-mass fraction eta=.25 (ground pressure to .75*surface pressure), upper specific-humidity ratio r=.1/.2/.3. With lower flow Ul (including fixed1km thermal shear) and projected stationary dry-column Ub, upper=(Ub-eta*Ul)/(1-eta). Dry mass weighted sum exactly Ub; water fractions eta/[eta+(1-eta)r] and remainder. Sum separate directional upwind fluxes and operators; do not upwind averaged velocity. Same branch faces in residual and boundary ledgers. Total W remains a single state: implicit instantaneous redistribution to a fixed vertical profile, no resolved vertical thermodynamics/momentum. Separate-branch upwinding adds resolution-dependent first-order mixing, not measured physical eddy diffusivity. Surface heat/lift/evaporation retain surface winds; no observed winds as forcing. Fixed hydrostatic M and flat-grid geometry remain approximations. New common-mass flag uses Mface*Uface*(W/M)_donor for every branch, K*Mface*grad(W/M) diffusion, and the same M in conservative storm exchange. Use the same mass-aware faces in matrix/residual/boundary diagnostics. Uniform specific humidity is a manufactured equilibrium for mass-balanced equal-q branches without physical sources. Not a new planetary or rain multiplier. Sources, saturation, vertical drying and imposed humidity-profile assumptions remain unchanged.
control: All7 original r39 climate/geography and3 native wind controls exact; next21 physical/numerical controls must reproduce EVERY archived NPZ field including observed masks/budgets/winds. Stop before candidates on any failed control. All non-original profiles .05/1024, unchanged .01 residual/linear/T tolerances. Preserve all previous failed solves.
screen: All strict numerical/conservative-vapor/storm checks and scaled column-mass residual<=1e-10 required. Same accuracy guards: S<=.995, mean rain ratio<=.99,T ratio<=1.01; NI rain ratio<=.95; Iran<=1.02; every other region S<=1.02. Actual integrated SST MAE increase<=.02C on identical observation-only masks, column speed max<=60m/s,p95<=25m/s. Fixed outside-wind guards: NI native partial-column vector RMSE improvement>=5%; Iberia ocean/EastAustralia lowland worsening<=2%, identical masks and areas. No additional candidate, weakened threshold or new validation sampling after outcomes. Also require two_layer_transport certificate with dry-column residual<=1e-10 and EACH branch wind maximum<=60m/s,p95<=25m/s (all primer/scored steps), rather than hiding a fast return in the weighted mean. Exactly3 fixed humidity ratios; no extra candidates after outcomes.

publication: Publish all49 outcomes and old-vs-corrected tracer known-answer diagnostics. Do not claim an operator consistency gain is a climate accuracy gain.
